summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a new share repurchase program. The Board authorized buybacks of up to US$200 million of common shares and Brazilian Depositary Receipts, effective June 18, 2026 until June 18, 2027, open market or privately negotiated. Funded from existing cash. CEO Rodrigo Barbosa emphasized capital returns alongside dividends; LTM yield ~4.5% after Q1 2026 dividend of US$0.78/share. The plan is opportunistic, with periodic board review. Watch for actual buyback execution rate and balance with growth capex; no regulatory clock or imbalanced risk.
